title: Effects of Creatine and Carbohydrate Supplementation on Endurance Performance
official: Effects of Creatine and Carbohydrate Supplementation on Endurance Performance
summary: This study will examine the independent and combined effects of creatine and carbohydrate supplementation on exercise performance, compared to placebo.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* healthy (i.e. no known cardiovascular disease)
* nonsmoking
* active (regular physical activity ≥150 minutes per week of aerobic exercise and have a VO2 peak ≥35 ml/kg-min)
* a normal BMI (18.5 - 35 kg/m\^2)
* between ages 18-40 years old

Exclusion Criteria:

* previously taken creatine and/or any other dietary supplement that may interfere with exercise performance
sponsor: California Polytechnic State University-San Luis Obispo
